name: cloudtrail_parse
description: Read AWS CloudTrail records — a file, a directory, or gzipped batches — and normalise them: who, what, from where, and whether it was refused. Resolves an assumed role back to the session that issued it, and counts the denials that are the shape of enumeration.

path.description: A CloudTrail .json or .json.gz file, or a directory of them

identity.description: Case-insensitive regex over the identity ARN or user name

notable_only.description: Only the API calls this tool flags

limit.description: Maximum records returned inline when out_file is set (default 500); the complete match set is written to out_file

out_file.description: Optional JSONL path for every matching normalised record; when absent every match is returned inline
